{"command": "cd /home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-24-formal/work/long-horizon.C.3 && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile, pathlib
from tools import normalize, word_counts

d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
p = pathlib.Path(d, "edge.csv")
# BOM + CRLF + blank/whitespace lines + comment with leading spaces + short row + inline '#'
p.write_bytes(
    "\ufeffa,1,x\r\n".encode("utf-8")
    + b"   \r\n"
    + b"\n"
    + b"   # indented comment\n"
    + b"b,2,\n"          # empty third field -> ignored by word_counts
    + b"c,3\n"           # short row -> ignored by word_counts
    + b"d,4, x \n"       # -> 'x' (strip)
    + b"e,5,#hash\n"     # '#' not at line start -> kept as data
    + b"f,6, \xc3\xa9t\xc3\xa9\n"  # unicode, no space handling issues
)
rows = normalize(str(p))
print("rows:", rows)
print("counts:", word_counts(rows))

# missing file / directory-as-path behaviour
print("missing:", normalize(os.path.join(d, "nope.csv")))

# row with 4+ fields: extra fields kept as-is, third field counted
print("extra:", normalize.__name__, word_counts([["a", "b", "c", "d"]]))
print("empty input:", word_counts([]), normalize(str(p)) != [])
PY
echo "exit=$?""}
